title: NeoAntiXray (Anti Xray)
body:

# NeoAntiXray

NeoAntiXray is a powerful Anti-XRay moderation plugin for Paper servers.

It helps staff detect suspicious mining behavior, monitor high-risk players, review ore statistics, and react quickly with advanced moderation tools. The plugin focuses on clean staff workflows, GUI-based controls, smart suspicion scoring, and optional manual X-Ray visualization for admins.

## Main Features

### Smart Ore Vein Detection

NeoAntiXray detects ore veins when players mine tracked ores.

It avoids repeated alerts from the same vein, so staff will not receive spam like:

```text
x10, x9, x8, x7...
```

Instead, the vein is detected once and reported clearly.

### Staff Alerts

Only staff members with the correct permission can see alerts.

Alerts include:

* Player name
* Ore type
* Vein size
* Suspicion information
* Location-related moderation context

### TopLuck System

The TopLuck GUI ranks players by suspicious mining statistics.

It includes:

* Online / Offline / All player modes
* Mode switch button
* Player heads
* Diamond / Stone ratio
* Ore statistics
* Suspicion score
* Player profile GUI

### Admin GUI

The `/nax` command opens the main admin interface.

The GUI includes access to:

* TopLuck
* Admin Tools
* Update Check
* Help
* History
* X-Ray controls

### Personal X-Ray Mode

Admins can use:

```text
/xray <on|off|status>
```

This enables a personal client-side X-Ray view for moderation.

When enabled:

* Non-ore blocks are shown as barrier blocks
* Ores remain visible
* Only the admin sees the fake blocks
* The real world is not changed
* Other players do not see anything

### AutoMod / AutoKick / AutoBan

NeoAntiXray includes automatic moderation tools.

The system uses a more conservative suspicion calculation to reduce false punishments for legitimate cave miners.

AutoBan progression:

* First ban: 1 day
* Second ban: 7 days
* Third ban: 30 days
* Fourth ban: permanent

When a player is banned by the plugin:

* Inventory is cleared
* Ender Chest is cleared
* A styled ban message is shown

### Update Checker

Admins receive update information on join.

The plugin can show:

* Outdated version
* Latest version
* Development version

The Modrinth update link is clickable in chat.

### Language Support

Default language: English
French can be supported through the plugin language system.

## Commands

```text
/nax
/topluck
/xray <on|off|status>
/autokick <on|off|status>
```

## Permissions

```text
neoantixray.admin
neoantixray.alerts
neoantixray.topluck
neoantixray.topluck.tp
neoantixray.update
neoantixray.stats
neoantixray.history
```

## Compatibility

```text
Paper 26.2
Java 21+
```
